lines.line: Why does a website load instantly the second time?
lines.adds_information: The avatar next to a laptop that is still loading shows the problem (waiting) before the narration answers it.

lines.line: Because a cache saves the answer.
lines.adds_information: A trophy on a podium makes "the saved answer" a visible object the avatar can point at.

lines.line: The first visit is slow. It fetches everything.
lines.adds_information: A counter climbing to 800 ms beside a typing laptop puts a number on the word slow.

lines.line: The next visit just reads the saved copy.
lines.adds_information: The same counter falling to 40 ms shows the improvement by comparison with the previous shot.
The avatar addresses the viewer while the plaque shows the exact keyword to comment.
